title: Same-date route change on a standard fare
facts_text: I am an adult on a verified easyJet standard fare. I want to change the destination airport to another available easyJet flight departing on the same calendar date. I bought the ticket 72 hours ago; the original flight leaves in 336 hours and the proposed flight in 338 hours. The replacement fare is also standard, is confirmed available, and is GBP 20 higher, and I will pay that increase. I am requesting the change through customer services, with booking authorization and consent already verified. I am not a Plus or Flight Club member and have no other change-fee benefit. There is no flight disruption.
request: Please change my destination as requested without charging the flight-change fee; I will pay the GBP 20 fare increase.

strict.reason: The base payment requirement applies without exceptions.
